complaints_anonymous_has_no_identity.name: complaints_anonymous_has_no_identity
complaints_anonymous_has_no_identity.value: "complaints"."channel" <> 'anonymous_web' or ("complaints"."complainant_name" is null and "complaints"."complainant_email" is null and "complaints"."complainant_phone" is null and "complaints"."created_by" is null)

enforcement_fines_one_basis.name: enforcement_fines_one_basis
enforcement_fines_one_basis.value: ("enforcement_fines"."judgment_step_id" is not null) <> ("enforcement_fines"."counsel_outcome_id" is not null)

order_service_events_server_rule.name: order_service_events_server_rule
order_service_events_server_rule.value: "order_service_events"."method" not in ('in_hand', 'abode') or ("order_service_events"."server_name" is not null and "order_service_events"."server_role" is not null)

ledger_allocations_line_fields.name: ledger_allocations_line_fields
ledger_allocations_line_fields.value:
"ledger_allocations"."target_kind" <> 'fee_assessment_line'
        or ("ledger_allocations"."application_id" is not null and "ledger_allocations"."fee_assessment_id" is not null
          and "ledger_allocations"."stage" is not null and "ledger_allocations"."fee_code" is not null)

ledger_allocations_fine_fields.name: ledger_allocations_fine_fields
ledger_allocations_fine_fields.value: "ledger_allocations"."target_kind" <> 'fine' or ("ledger_allocations"."fine_id" is not null and "ledger_allocations"."application_id" is null)

ledger_entries_reverses.name: ledger_entries_reverses
ledger_entries_reverses.value:
("ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'payment' and "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is null)
        or ("ledger_entries"."entry_type" <> 'payment' and "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is not null)

ledger_entries_reason.name: ledger_entries_reason
ledger_entries_reason.value: "ledger_entries"."entry_type" not in ('refund', 'returned_check', 'correction') or "ledger_entries"."reason" is not null

ledger_entries_processor_triple.name: ledger_entries_processor_triple
ledger_entries_processor_triple.value:
("ledger_entries"."processor" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."processor_account_id" is null)
        and ("ledger_entries"."processor" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."processor_object_id" is null)

review_assignments_active_board_idx.name: review_assignments_active_board_idx
review_assignments_active_board_idx.where: "review_assignments"."removed_at" is null and "review_assignments"."board_id" is not null

review_assignments_board_comment_by.name: review_assignments_board_comment_by
review_assignments_board_comment_by.value: "review_assignments"."comment_by" is null or "review_assignments"."board_id" is not null
